findings.claim: The diff adds around 15 multi-line comment blocks (several 2-5 lines, including a 5-line JSDoc on a single key) that narrate design decisions, whereas the repo convention calls for comments to be one line, rare, and reserved for explaining a non-obvious why.
A comment is placed directly above an it(...) test case, which the testing conventions doc prohibits ('No comments above test cases').

The spending limit tile is now marked isAvailable: true and clickable, but startSpendingLimitFlow is an empty TODO (WA-3150), so after the first click (which only closes the intro dialog and marks it seen) the tile does nothing on subsequent clicks.
There is no test verifying that clicking 'Set up spending limit' calls closeSpendingLimitIntro(); if this call were removed from index.tsx, no existing test would catch the regression.

dark:text-black is a hard-coded color value instead of a theme variable, which apps/web/AGENTS.md requires; --primary-foreground already resolves to the same color (#0a0a0a) in the dark theme and could be used instead.
